note: Editable assumptions for the projections. Nothing here changes the measured pilot results. The budget is the instructor's limit of $10 for the 100,000-review run (email of 2026-10-11); the full-corpus scenarios are shown for reference and exceed it.

planned_run.description: The 100,000 reviews with the lowest SHA-256(seed:review_id) values, the course's own sampling rule, which contain the golden 50 and all three development files, plus the 13 empty-text reviews. The instructor allowed a run of at least 100,000 reviews.

output_token_cap_per_request.enrich: not applicable: Jev returns fixed typed answers and output tokens are free

controls.fallback_note: No fallback model is used. On the hand-labeled golden set the verifier model was no closer to the human labels than the enricher (11 versus 12 disagreements of 50), so routing texts to it was not justified.

base.description: Exact-text reuse on, 8 workers, few retries, no fallback.

conservative.description: Exact-text reuse on, 4 workers at lower efficiency, more retries, longer texts, one rejected memo.
